🇷🇺 Russian strikes hit Ukrainian military-industrial targets Overnight, the AFU facilities in 10 regions were targeted by combined missile and drone attacks. Focus was on energy, industry, and transport infrastructure. Key impacts: - Substation "Zarechye" (110 kV) in Belaya Tserkov damaged. - Four locomotives disabled via drones in Sinelnikovo ( Dnepropetrovsk ), Korosten ( Zhitomir ), and Lyubotin ( Kharkov ). - Fuel tank fire at port of Kilia near Odessa . - Strikes on Chernigov Auto Plant and NPK "Progress" in Nezhin. The latter produces high-precision optics for AFU drones and missiles. Expert Yuri Kotenok noted significant damage to production facilities. He emphasized the need to disrupt foreign component supply chains and destroy hardened industrial sites using FAB bombs with UMPC kits to prevent Kiev from manufacturing long-range weapons. @Slavyangrad
